Line 2 declares parameters as `int` and return type as `long`; the widening of the product to the return type is implicit.

For probe p1 (50000, 50000) the product 2,500,000,000 exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE, so the cast on line 3 is what prevents int overflow.
